text:
maya: Quick sync — I ran a sampling pass on audit events and found coverage gaps across api-gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Need a quick triage + backlog pickup. cc @simon @leo

simon: where's the sampling report?

maya: s3://redwood-audit-samples/2026-03-19/summary.csv — high-level: api-gw missing auth.success/auth.failure for our gRPC proxy; auth service emits login but not token-refresh; console missing role.change and role.assign events; billing missing invoice.access and invoice.download; runtime missing model.pull / model.load events tied to customer_id. Two customer evidence requests came in yesterday.

ali: which customers? impacted severity?

maya: custA and custB asked for audit trails while onboarding. Not high-sev but needs evidence for compliance. I've opened ticket INV-8245 for cust outreach.

sec-bot: Created SEC-2026: audit-evidence-request (assigned to @ali)

leo: I'll take api-gw + auth. simon can you pick billing + runtime? ali can own console + customer comms?

simon: yep will pick billing + runtime scrape.

maya: Proposed plan: 1) triage & map missing events to producers, 2) add fields to canonical audit schema (optional/back-compat), 3) small service PRs to emit events + request_id trace, 4) add unit + integration tests, 5) run sampling job and validate, 6) ship and notify customers. Timeline: triage today, PRs tomorrow, tests + rollout early next week.

ali: do we have a canonical schema spec and a place to add new event types?

leo: yes, libs/auditproto service contains proto v1. We should add optional fields (request_id, actor_type, resource_labels) and bump to v1.1 so consumers can stay compatible.

maya: draft proto snippet for discussion:

```proto
message AuditEvent {
  string event_type = 1;
  string user_id = 2;
  string actor_type = 3; // user/service/automation
  string resource_id = 4;
  string request_id = 5;
  map<string,string> metadata = 6;
}
```

simon: SGTM. For billing invoice.access we should include invoice_id, caller_role, and ip_address. For runtime model.pull include model_hash and quantized boolean.

ali: customers asked for signed evidence. Can we sign exported audit bundles? KMS integration question: hosted -> HMAC signing with service key, Private -> KMS/HSM sign. Thoughts?

leo: that's feasible. Hosted can produce HMAC-SHA256 signatures stored alongside bundles; Private deployments can use their KMS. We'll need to surface signing metadata in the schema (signature, signer_key_id).

maya: Action items (owners + due):
- leo: create api-gw PR to emit auth.success/auth.failure and request_id (due EOD today)
- simon: add billing invoice.access + runtime model.pull to billing/runtime services and wire to audit pipeline (due tomorrow)
- ali: console role.change + customer comms for INV-8245 (due EOD today)
- maya: open schema PR in libs/auditproto with optional fields + test harness (due today)
- sec-bot: create playbook checklist and evidence export steps (auto)

simon: I'll need prod read-only access to logs for sampling and validation.

maya: @sre-oncall can you approve simon's temporary access?

sre-oncall: Granting read-only logs access for 24h to simon, done. :white_check_mark:

ali: Need to add regression tests: sample actions -> assert audit event emitted. Can we add this to CI gating on the services?

leo: yes, add small integration asserts in service test suites and a nightly sampling validation job that compares expected event types to emitted counts.

maya: Also consider a lightweight rollout strategy: canary emit + verify in staging, then gradual flip with feature flag to avoid burst to pipeline.

ali: For schema changes, prefer optional fields + clear migration notes. If any consumer still errors, fallback to drop-in shim in audit-ingest that maps old to new.

maya: I'll post a short triage doc in the ticket with the mapping + example queries to extract evidence for custA/custB. Sync call at 15:00 PT in #eng-security if anyone needs live coordination.

simon: thumbs up. I'll start on billing runtime PR now.

leo: taking api-gw.

ali: starting console PR and customer note.

sec-bot: Created playbook SEC-2026-checklist and linked INV-8245.

maya: thanks everyone. We'll update this thread when PRs are created. :thumbsup:
